analyze_contribution.rationale: Governed. Runs contribution-analysis queries over caller-selected tables or SQL, consuming BigQuery compute and potentially processing sensitive data.

ask_data_insights.rationale: Governed. Sends a natural-language request and selected BigQuery table context to Google Cloud Conversational Analytics, with data-disclosure and billable-service implications.

execute_sql.rationale: Governed. Executes caller-supplied GoogleSQL; with the official prebuilt source defaulting to writeMode=allowed, this can mutate or delete datasets and tables, trigger large billable scans, or exfiltrate query results.

forecast.rationale: Governed. Runs billable forecasting analysis over caller-selected tables or SQL and may process sensitive time-series data.

get_dataset_info.rationale: Pass-through. Read-only dataset metadata lookup with no remote state change.

get_table_info.rationale: Pass-through. Read-only table metadata lookup with no remote state change.

list_dataset_ids.rationale: Pass-through. Read-only dataset enumeration with no remote state change.

list_table_ids.rationale: Pass-through. Read-only table enumeration with no remote state change.

search_catalog.rationale: Pass-through. Read-only Dataplex catalog search with no remote state change.
